description: Subscribe the current OpenWeb Ninja API key to an API's free (BASIC) tier so that API's tool can be used. Call this when another tool returns a subscription/entitlement error: HTTP 401/403, or a 429 "Too Many Requests" when you have not subscribed to that API yet. Pass api_id = the name of the tool you want to use (e.g. "realtime_image_search"). Free tier only: it never incurs charges and will not alter an existing paid subscription. After it succeeds, wait a few seconds for it to take effect, then retry the original tool.

api_id.description: The id of the API/tool to subscribe to (same as the tool name, e.g. "jsearch").

name: subscribe
